name: zopt_get_network_enabled
description: zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled returns the current network-enabled option value.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x408260 loads ZOPT_NETWORK_ENABLED and returns the pointed-to integer value.

The native zOpt network accessor smoke installs local option storage, verifies the disabled value through zOpt::GetNetworkEnabled, calls zOpt::SetNetworkEnabled(1), and verifies the enabled value is returned.
